items.title: Global bond sell-off pressures stocks: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Tech stocks took a leg lower amid concerns about rising borrowing costs.

items.title: Intel Tripled in a Year. Here’s Where It’ll Reach in Another 12 Months
items.summary: Intel shares are up over 300% in a year, but Wall Street still has serious doubts, and the gap between the consensus target and the bull case reveals a high-stakes bet on whether one unproven technology can rewrite the entire story.

items.title: What’s Moving the Market Today?
items.summary: U.S. stocks are trading lower today. The Nasdaq is down 1.4%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average is off 0.1% and the S&P 500 is down 0.6%. Here is what is driving the markets today:  Worldwide bond selloff: An accelerating bond selloff in recent days has pushed some Treasury yields to levels not seen since 2007.

items.title: BofA Sees Nvidia Trading at Up to 50% Discount on AI Risks
items.summary: Nvidia Corp. shares could be trading at a discount of as much as 50%, as investors overstate risks related to the leader in artificial intelligence chips, according to Bank of America.

items.title: Inside NVIDIA’s Portfolio: A $30 Billion Intel Bet and Other Surprising Holdings
items.summary: NVIDIA's first public 13F filing surprised Wall Street with a portfolio that reads less like passive investing and more like a strategic blueprint for controlling the entire AI supply chain. Five of its holdings reveal exactly where Jensen Huang thinks the real money flows after the GPU.

items.title: Why Intel, Marvell Stocks Are Dropping After Chip Stocks Enter New Bull Market
items.summary: Chip stocks spent just 21 days in bear market territory. But that’s where the good news ends on Tuesday.

items.title: Intel Owns Just 2 Stocks Worth $620 Million: Here’s What That Concentrated Bet Reveals
items.summary: Intel sits on roughly $30 billion in cash, yet its entire disclosed stock portfolio fits inside just two struggling companies tied to autonomous flight and self-driving cars. The reasoning behind that concentrated bet says more about CEO Lip-Bu Tan's grand vision than any earnings call ever could.

items.title: Intel and AMD Fall 4% as 13F Filings Reveal Concentrated Chip Bets
items.summary: Quarterly institutional filings just revealed which major tech rivals and hedge funds were crowding into the same chip stock before Tuesday's sharp selloff, and the concentration levels are raising eyebrows across Wall Street.
